note: Original PersonalityDNA descriptive text for reports. It describes tendencies people report about themselves, not abilities, and is not a diagnosis.
values_note: A personal values questionnaire is not available yet, so this report does not describe your values. You can explore what matters to you in the growth programme "Know yourself, set a direction".
general_limitations: This report is based only on your own answers. It describes how you see yourself at the moment you answered.
Scores show where you sit on the response scale. They are not percentiles and do not compare you with other people.
Results can change over time and with circumstances. Nothing here is a diagnosis or a measure of ability.
Do not use this report to make hiring, promotion or other selection decisions about anyone.

higher.communication: You may enjoy conversations that explore ideas and possibilities. Others may need concrete examples to follow you.
higher.relationships: You may bring new ideas and experiences into relationships. Check that the other person also wants change right now.

middle.communication: You can usually move between big-picture talk and practical detail, depending on who you are talking to.
middle.relationships: You can often meet people halfway between trying something new and keeping familiar routines.

lower.communication: You may prefer conversations that stay practical and concrete. Saying so can help others get to the point.
lower.relationships: You may offer steadiness and reliability. Now and then, try something new together on purpose.

higher.communication: You may like clear agendas, plans and follow-through, and may notice when others are less prepared.
higher.relationships: You may show care by being dependable. Agree together which plans matter, so flexibility doesn't feel like a let-down.

middle.communication: You can plan when it matters and stay flexible when it doesn't.
middle.relationships: You can often balance plans with spontaneity. Talk about which plans really matter to each of you.

lower.communication: You may prefer open, flexible conversations to fixed agendas. Confirming next steps in writing can help others.
lower.relationships: You may bring spontaneity. Following up on small promises helps the people who rely on you.

higher.communication: You may think out loud and enjoy lively discussion. Leaving pauses gives quieter people room to speak.
higher.relationships: You may bring energy and social plans. Check how much social time the other person wants.

middle.communication: You can enjoy both group discussion and one-to-one conversation, depending on your energy.
middle.relationships: You can often adapt between busy and quiet time together.

lower.communication: You may prefer to think before speaking and to talk one to one. Asking for time to reflect is a fair request.
lower.relationships: You may value quiet time together. Saying when you need to recharge helps others not take it personally.

higher.communication: You may focus on harmony and others' feelings. Saying your own view clearly is part of good communication too.
higher.relationships: You may be warm and accommodating. Make sure your own needs are heard as well.

middle.communication: You can usually balance being considerate with saying what you think.
middle.relationships: You can often balance looking after others with standing up for yourself.

lower.communication: You may be direct and comfortable with debate. Saying what you appreciate first can help your points land.
lower.relationships: You may be honest and straightforward. Checking how your words land helps others feel heard.

higher.communication: You may stay calm in tense conversations. Others may still need you to acknowledge their worries.
higher.relationships: You may offer steadiness when things are hard. Remember that others may feel more strongly than you do.

middle.communication: You may feel some pressure in tense conversations but usually recover.
middle.relationships: You can often support others and ask for support when you need it.

lower.communication: You may feel strong emotions in tense conversations. Taking a pause before replying can help.
lower.relationships: You may notice worries early. Telling people what helps you feel steady makes support easier.
